en: ...absolute opposition holds.

One kind of the oppositions is the manifoldness of the living; the living must be considered as organizations; the manifoldness of life is opposed, one part of this manifoldness (and this part is itself an infinite manifoldness, because it is living) is considered merely in relation, having its being only as union, — the other part (also an infinite manifoldness) is considered only in opposition, having its being only through the separation from that part, and thus that part too is determined as having its being only through the separation from this one.
The first part is called an organization, an individual.

It is evident of itself that this life, whose manifoldness is considered only in relation, whose being is this relation, can at the same time also be considered partly as in itself different, as mere multitude; its relation is no longer absolute as the separation of that which is related; partly it must also be thought with the possibility of entering into relation with what it excludes, the possibility of the loss of individuality, or of connection with what is excluded; — likewise the manifold that is excluded from an organic whole, which has its being only in opposition, must at the same time be posited partly not [only] as for itself, abstracted from that organization, absolutely manifold in itself, but as at the same time standing in relation within itself, — partly also in union with the living being excluded from it.

The concept of individuality includes in itself opposition against infinite manifoldness and connection with it; a human being is an individual life insofar as he is other than all elements and than the infinity of individual lives outside him; he is an individual life only insofar as he is one with all elements, with all infinity of lives outside him; — he is only insofar as the whole of life is divided, he the one part, all the rest the other part; he is only insofar as he is no part and nothing is separated from him.

The undivided life presupposed, fixed, we can then consider the living127) as expressions of life, as presentations of it, whose manifoldness — which, precisely because expressions are posited, is at the same time posited, and indeed posited as infinite — reflection then fixes as resting, subsisting, as fixed points, as individuals; — or a living being presupposed, and indeed we the contemplating ones, then the life posited outside our bounded life is an infinite life of infinite manifoldness, infinite opposition, infinite relation; as multitude an infinite multitude of organizations, individuals, as unity a single organized, separated and united whole — nature.

It is a positing of life, for reflection has brought into life its concepts of relation and separation, of the singular, subsisting for itself, and the universal, connected, the former as something bounded, the latter as something unbounded, and has made it into nature through positing.
zh: ……绝对的对立有效。
对立的一种就是活的东西的众多；活的东西必须被看作组织；生命的众多被对立起来，这个众多的一个部分（而这个部分本身是一个无限的众多，因为它是活的）只被从关系中考察，它的存在只是作为结合才有的，——另一个部分（也是一个无限的众多）只被从对立中考察，它的存在只是通过对那一部分的分离才有的，而这样一来，那一个部分也就同样被规定为：它的存在只是通过对这个部分的分离才有的。
第一个部分叫做组织，叫做个体。

这本身就清楚：这个生命，它的杂多只被从关系中考察，它的存在就是这种关系，它同时也可以一部分被看作在自身中不同的、单纯的众多；它的关系不再绝对地是这种被关联者的分离；一部分也必须被思考为带有与它所排除的东西进入关系的可能性，即丧失个体性的可能性，或者与被排除的东西联结的可能性；——同样，那被一个有机整体所排除的杂多，它的存在只在对立中，也必须同时一部分不只是被设定为自为的、抽离了那个组织的、在自身中绝对杂多的，而是被设定为在自身中同时处于关系之中的，——一部分也被设定为与那个被它排除的活的东西相结合。
个体性的概念在自身中包括对无限的杂多的对立以及同这杂多的联结；一个人是个体性的生命，只要他不同于一切元素，也不同于他之外那些个体性生命的无限性；他只是一个个体性的生命，只要他与一切元素、与他之外一切生命的无限性是一；——他只有在生命的全体被分开、他是一部分而其余一切都是另一部分时才存在；他只有在他不是部分、没有什么东西从他那里被分离出去时才存在。

把未分开的生命设为前提、固定下来，那么我们就可以把活的东西127)看作生命的表达、看作生命的呈现，它们的杂多——正因为在设定表达，这杂多也就同时被设定，而且是被设定为无限的——反思随后把它固定为静止的、持续存在的，固定为一些固定的点，固定为个体；——或者把某一个活的东西设为前提，而且是把我们这些考察者设为前提，那么被设定在我们有限的生命之外的生命，就是一个无限的生命，有着无限的杂多、无限的对立、无限的关系；作为众多，它是组织、个体的无限的众多；作为统一，它是一个唯一的、组织起来的、既分离又结合的整体——自然。
它是一种对生命的设定，因为反思把它那些关于关系和分离、关于单个的、自为地持续存在的东西以及关于普遍的、被联结起来的东西的概念——前者作为被限制者，后者作为无限制者——带进了生命，并通过设定把它变成了自然。

en: Since now life, as the infinity of the living or as an infinity of shapes, in this way as nature is an infinitely finite, an unboundedly bounded thing, is this union of the finite and the infinite and the separation of the same within it, since nature is not itself life but a life fixed by reflection, though treated most worthily, so the life that contemplates and thinks nature still feels, or whatever one wants to call it, this contradiction, this single opposition of itself to infinite life that still persists — or reason still recognizes the one-sidedness of this positing, this contemplating —, and this thinking life lifts out of the shape, out of the mortal, transitory, infinitely self-opposed, self-combating [realm], the living, free from what passes away, the relation without the dead and self-killing [element] of manifoldness, not a unity, a thought relation, but all-living, all-powerful, infinite life, and calls it God, is no longer thinking or contemplating, because its object carries nothing reflected, dead in itself128).
zh: 因为生命作为活的东西的无限性、或者作为形态的无限性，以这种方式作为自然，是一个无限地被限定的东西、一个无限制地被限制的东西，是有限者与无限者的这种结合以及它们在它里面的分离，而自然本身并不是生命，而是被反思——尽管是最配得上地被反思——固定下来的生命，所以，那个考察自然、思考生命的生命还感受着——或者随人怎么叫它——这个矛盾，这个它自身对无限生命的唯一的、仍然存在的对立——或者说，理性还认识到这种设定、这种考察的单面性——，而这个思考着的生命就从形态中，从会死的、消逝的、无限地自身对立着、自身争斗着的东西中，把活的东西提出来，这活的东西摆脱了消逝者，是那种不带杂多中死东西和自相杀死自己的东西的关系，不是一种统一、一种被思考的关系，而是全活生生的、全有力量的、无限的生命，并把它叫做神，这时它就不再思考、不再考察了，因为它的对象在自身中不带有任何被反思的、死的东西128)。

en: This elevation of the human being, not from the finite to the infinite — for these are only products of mere reflection, and as such their separation is absolute — but from finite life to infinite life, is religion.

Infinite life can be called a spirit, in contrast to abstract multitude, for spirit is the living unity of the manifold in contrast to it as its shape, which constitutes the manifoldness lying in the concept of life, not in contrast to it as a manifold separated from it, dead, mere multitude; for then it would be the mere unity that is called law and is something merely thought, lifeless.
Spirit is enlivening law in union with the manifold, which is then an enlivened one.

When the human being posits this enlivened manifoldness as a multitude of many and yet in connection with the enlivening [element], then these single lives become organs, the infinite whole an infinite all of life; when he posits infinite life as the spirit of the whole at the same time outside himself, because he himself is something bounded, posits himself at the same time outside himself, the bounded, and raises himself up to the living, unites himself most intimately with it, then he worships God.
zh: 人的这种提升，不是从有限者到无限者——因为这两者只是单纯反思的产物，而作为这样的产物，它们的分离是绝对的——，而是从有限的生命到无限的生命，这就是宗教。
无限的生命可以叫做精神，与抽象的众多相对，因为精神是杂多的活的统一，它与作为自己形态的杂多相对——这形态构成着生命的概念中所包含的杂多——，而不是与那种同它分离的、死的、单纯众多的杂多相对；因为那样的话，它就是那种单纯叫做法律的统一，是单纯被思考的东西，没有生命。
精神是与杂多相结合中的赋予生命的法律，这杂多于是就是被赋予生命的。
当人把这种被赋予生命的杂多同时设定为许多东西的众多、却又设定为与赋予生命的东西的联结时，这些单个的生命就成了器官，这无限的整体就成了生命的无限的全体；当他同时把无限的生命作为整体的精神设定在自己之外——因为他自己是一个被限制的东西——，同时又把自己设定在自己、这个被限制的东西之外，把自己提升到活的东西那里，与它最内在地结合起来，那么他就是在敬拜神。

en: Even though the manifold is here no longer posited as such, but occurs throughout in relation to the living spirit, as enlivened, as organ, something would thereby still be excluded and thus an incompleteness and an opposition would remain, namely the dead; in other words, if the manifold is posited in relation only as organ, then the opposition itself is excluded, but life cannot be considered as union, relation alone, but must at the same time be considered as opposition; if I say it is the connection of opposition and relation, then this connection can itself again be isolated and it can be objected that it would stand opposed to non-connection; I would have to express myself [by saying] that life is the connection of connection and non-connection, i.e. every expression is a product of reflection, and consequently of each one, as of something posited, it can be shown that with the positing of something, at the same time another is not posited, is excluded; but this being-driven-on without a resting point must once and for all be checked by not forgetting that, for example, what was called the connection of synthesis and antithesis is not something posited, intelligible, reflected, but that its single character for reflection is that it is a being outside reflection.

In the living whole, death, opposition, the understanding is at the same time posited, namely as a manifold that is living and, as living, can posit itself as a whole, whereby it is at the same time a part, i.e. for which there are dead things and which is itself dead for others.

This being-a-part of the living is sublated in religion, bounded life raises itself to the infinite; and only because the finite is itself life does it bear in itself the possibility of raising itself to infinite life.

Philosophy must for that very reason come to an end together with religion, because the former is a thinking, and thus has an opposition, partly of non-thinking, partly of the thinking [subject] and the thought [object]; it has to point out finitude in everything finite and to demand through reason the completion of the same, especially to recognize the deceptions through its own infinite and thus to place the true infinite outside its own circle.

The elevation of the finite to the infinite characterizes itself precisely thereby as the elevation of finite life to infinite [life], as religion, that it does not posit the being of the infinite as a being through reflection, as an objective or a subjective one, so that it added to the bounded the bounding, recognized this again as something posited, itself as something bounded, and anew sought the bounding for it and made the demand to continue this into the infinite; this activity of reason too is an elevation to the infinite, but this infinite is a ...129)
zh: 即使杂多在这里不再作为杂多被设定，而是处处都与活的精神相关，作为被赋予生命的、作为器官出现，这样一来毕竟还是会有某种东西被排除，因而仍然留下一种不完整和一种对立，即死的东西；换句话说，如果杂多只是作为器官被设定在关系中，那么对立本身就被排除了，但生命恰恰不能只被看作结合、关系，而必须同时被看作对立；如果我说它是对立和关系的联结，那么这种联结本身又可以再次被孤立起来，并且可以反驳说，它与非联结相对立；那我就得这样说：生命是联结和非联结的联结，也就是说，任何表达都是反思的产物，因此对于任何一个作为被设定者的表达都可以指出，随着某种东西被设定，同时就有另一种东西没有被设定、被排除了；但是，这种没有停歇点的被不断推着往前，必须一劳永逸地加以阻止，办法就是不要忘记：例如那个被叫做综合与反题之联结的东西，并不是一个被设定的、知性的、被反思的东西，而它对于反思来说唯一的特征就是，它是反思之外的存在。
在活生生的整体中，死、对立、知性也同时被设定了，即被设定为一种杂多，这种杂多是活的，并且作为活的东西能够把自己设定为一个整体，因此它同时是一个部分，也就是说，对它来说有死的东西，而它自己对于别的东西来说也是死的。
活的东西的这种部分存在，在宗教中被扬弃了，被限制的生命把自己提升到无限者；而且只是由于有限者本身就是生命，它才在自身中带有把自己提升到无限生命的可能性。
哲学正因此必须与宗教一起终止，因为前者是一种思维，因而有一种对立，一部分是与不思维的对立，一部分是思维者与被思维者的对立；它必须在一切有限者中指出有限性，并通过理性要求对有限者的补全，尤其要认出由它自己的无限者而来的种种迷惑，从而把真正的无限者置于它自己的范围之外。
有限者向无限者的提升，正因此而表明自己是有限的生命向无限生命的提升，是宗教：它并不把无限者的存在设定为一种通过反思而有的存在，不设定为一种客观的或主观的存在，以致它给被限制者加上限制者，又把这个限制者认作一个被设定者、本身认作一个被限制者，并重新为它寻找限制者，还提出要求说，要把这一过程无限地继续下去；理性的这种活动也是一种向无限者的提升，但这个无限者是一个……129)

en: ...an objective centre; for all peoples it was the morning region of the temple, and for the worshippers of an invisible God only this shapeless [thing] of determinate space, only a place.

But this merely opposed, purely objective, merely spatial [thing] must not necessarily remain in this incompleteness of complete objectivity; it can itself, i.e. as existing for itself, return through shape to its own subjectivity.

Divine feeling, the infinite felt from the finite, is first completed by reflection being added and dwelling over it; but a relation of the latter to feeling is only a cognition of it as something subjective, only a consciousness of feeling, separated reflection over the separated feeling; pure, spatial objectivity gives the point of union for many, and shaped objectivity is at the same time, as what it ought to be, through the subjectivity connected with it, not an actual but only a possible objectivity; it can be thought as such, but it is not necessary, because it is not pure.

And thereby, just as above the antinomy of time, the moment and the time of life was posited as necessary, the objective antinomy with regard to the object is also posited; the being that is infinite in the immeasurableness of space is at the same time in determinate space, roughly as in the [verse]:
zh: ……一个客观的中心；对一切民族来说，它是神庙的东方，而对一个不可见的神的崇拜者来说，只是确定空间里的这个无形的东西，只是一个位置。
但这个单纯被对立起来的东西、纯粹客观的东西、单纯空间性的东西，并不必然停留在这完全客观性的不完整之中；它本身，也就是作为自为地存在的东西，可以通过形态回到自己的主体性。

神圣的感受，即从有限者那里被感受到的无限者，只有通过反思加入进来、停留于其上，才得到补全；但反思与感受的关系，只是把感受认作某种主观的东西，只是对感受的一种意识，是在被分离的感受之上的被分离的反思；纯粹的空间性的客观性给许多东西提供了结合点，而具有形态的客观性——即它应当是的东西——同时通过与之相结合的主体性，并不是一种现实的客观性，而只是一种可能的客观性；它可以被当作这样的东西来思考，但这并不是必然的，因为它并不纯粹。
而这样一来，正如上面时间的二律背反、瞬间和生命的时间被设定为必然的那样，与对象有关的客观的二律背反也被设定了；在空间的不可度量性中无限的本质，同时又在确定的空间中，大约就像在这样一句里：

en: Him whom the heaven of all heavens did not enclose, he now lies in Mary's lap.
zh: 诸天之天都容不下的他，如今躺在马利亚的怀里。

en: In religious life, its relation to objects, its acting as a keeping-alive or as an enlivening of them, was shown, but [it is] reminded of its fate, by virtue of which it must also let what is objective stand as objective, or even itself make living things into objects.

It may be that this making-objective must be only for the moment, and that life again withdraws from it, frees itself from it, and leaves what has been suppressed to its own life and its resurrection.
But it is necessary that it also enters into a lasting relation with objects, preserves objectivity for them to the point of complete annihilation.

With all the increased religious union shown by the completions so far, hypocrisy can still take place, namely through particular property kept back for oneself; with the firm possession of things, the human being would not have fulfilled the — negatively expressed — conditions of religion, namely to be free of absolute objectivity, to have raised himself above finite life; he would be incapable of union with infinite life, because he would still have kept something for himself, would still be caught in a dominating or entangled in a dependence; and therefore he gives up part of his property, whose necessity is his fate, as a sacrifice — only some of it, for his fate is necessary and cannot be sublated; he also destroys a part before the deity, from the destruction of the rest he takes away the particularity, as far as possible, through community with friends, and through the fact that it is a purposeless surplus; and through this purposelessness of destruction alone, through this destroying for the sake of destroying, he makes good his otherwise particular relation of purposive destruction and has at the same time completed the objectivity of the objects through a destruction not related to himself, their complete relatelessness, death, and even if the necessity of a relating destruction of objects remains, yet this purposeless destroying for the sake of destroying sometimes occurs, which proves itself to be the only religious [act] toward absolute objects.
zh: 在宗教生活中，它同对象的关系、它作为把对象保持为活的或赋予对象生命的行动被指了出来，但它也被提醒自己的命运：由于这命运，它也必须让客观的东西作为客观的东西存在下去，甚至自己把活的东西变成对象。
也可能这种对象化只在瞬间才是必需的，生命又重新离开它，把自己从它那里解放出来，把被压制的东西留给它自己的生命和这生命的复活。
但它也必然要同对象进入一种持久的关系，为对象把客观性一直保持到彻底的消灭。

即使有迄今为止种种补全所显示出来的那种增多了的宗教结合，伪善仍然可能出现，也就是通过特殊的、为自己保留的财产；如果人牢牢地占有东西，他就没有满足——用否定的话说——宗教的条件，即摆脱绝对的客观性、把自己提升到有限的生命之上；他会无力与无限的生命结合，因为他还有某种东西是为自己保留的，还陷在一种支配之中，或者受一种依赖的束缚；因此他把自己财产的一部分作为献祭交出去，——只交出一些，因为他的命运是必然的，不能被扬弃；他也在神面前消灭一部分，而对其余部分的消灭，他则通过与朋友们的共同分享、以及通过它是一种无目的的过剩，尽可能地把特殊性拿掉；仅仅通过这种消灭的无目的性，通过这种为消灭而消灭，他就补偿了自己其余那种有目的地消灭的特殊关系，同时也通过一种不涉及自身的消灭，通过它们的完全无关系性，即死，把对象的客观性完成了；而即使对对象的一种有关系的消灭仍然必要，这种为消灭而消灭的无目的的消灭有时还是会出现，它证明自己是面对绝对对象的唯一宗教性的东西。
